Q5738.reason: A mixed goods and services contract falls under the UCC unless the services are the predominant purpose, so Connie prevails under the UCC unless the service agreement predominates.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at the time of entry, and he entered the open party only to have a good time, forming the intent to steal later.

Q8324.reason: The agitated, drug-seeking presentation fits addiction or withdrawal, where chronic use downregulates post-synaptic dopamine receptors, and nothing suggests neuronal death.
